title: QA: the hidden escape portal
eyebrow: Record of issue #551 (The arrival portal closes and a hidden escape portal opens) and the guard merge. You asked to skip QA, so this is for reference only

qa.feature: The arrival portal closes and a hidden escape portal opens
unverified: Nobody has played it by hand.
The Ophan did not come in the checks, because the raid clock was moved by hand instead of waiting 5 minutes.
Hearing the hum: the checks read that it plays at the portal with a 60 m reach, but nobody listened to it.
The last runs after the guard merge have pictures but no video, because screen recording stopped producing frames.

short.lead: The arrival portal closes 20 seconds into a raid. With a minute left, as the Ophan arrives, a portal opens in a room in the farthest third of the castle, the same room on every machine. It hums up to 60 m away and glows. Standing in it for 4 seconds takes out whoever is on it; anyone else is left behind. The guard work is merged in. In co-op checks both machines matched at every step, and the guard tests pass (36 editor, 185 in play).
short.hint: Play a raid in co-op with bash Tools/Unity/coop_local.sh; each item says what you should see.
items: The arrival portal closes at 20 seconds
Set out and wait by the portal. After 20 seconds it collapses with a sound and standing there does nothing.
Tell me if it closes at the wrong time or not at all.
Find the escape portal by its hum
Stay until the last minute. As the Ophan arrives, a hum starts somewhere deep in the castle. Follow it until you see the portal's glow.
Tell me if the hum is too quiet or too loud, or the room too easy or too hard to reach.
One player stands in the escape portal for 4 seconds. They leave with what is in it; the other is left behind.
Tell me if anyone on the pad is left behind, or anyone off it is saved.
